notes.title: Epilogue Update
notes.content:
[b]In order to see the Epilogue, you have to beat the game with 12 or more spark![/b]
There's a secret way to get there revealed behind Simeon's bar that you can share with friends, but its only there at the epilogue area!

🎮 Additions 🎮
[list]
[*] added text for customization
[*] added Epilogue level where you can exit the Casino and visit the Rat Church
[*] added an O.o.B. secret
[*] added a mirror in the intro closet to see your choices
[*] added a model viewer in the Museum with lore for characters
[*] added a 'credits' option that takes you straight to the museum
[*] added three new heads in the Epilogue from fan characters
[*] added a new skybox
[*] added Group Chat segments, in the epilogue listen to the cherubs converse with each other
[*] added a Rat Church, in the epilogue visit and see all the fan art. Read the book for credits.
[*] added a playable organ, in the epilogue visit the Rat Church to play
[*] added a new character Hyssop, in the epilogue go find it and have a chat.
[*] added Social Media buttons to Title screen. Give a follow if interested in future projects.
[*] added secret camera button at bottom right of settings screen to disable ratio and pixel effects.
[/list]

🔧 Tweaks 🔧
[list]
[*] stairwell is now level, no more seams. Lighting bug on 'low' fixed
[*]tweaked lighting in closet on 'low' 
[*] tweaked footstep randomness audio
[/list]

🪲 Bug Fixes 🪲
[list]
[*]fixed a bug where you would be soft locked if falling out of bounds during Ratman encounter
[/list]

If you find any bugs, and we're sure you will, please share in the Community hub! 
Thank you all for the support on this project. It means so much to us. This is a big thank you to all our supporters. 

-rat

notes.title: hotfix
notes.content: Steven the rat didn't want people to leave his secret kitchen after relaunching the game. You are now free to leave.

notes.title: Photomode Update
notes.content:
🎮 Additions 🎮
[list]
[*] Added a new secret for the [i]luckiest[/i] players
[*] Added an unlockable photomode. Try to find the camera!
[*] Added a second table to Tychos room
[/list]

🔧 Tweaks 🔧
[list]
[*] Can no longer interact with Rexlas bass before talking to her. 
[*] Elevator no longer shakes the camera when going up
[/list]

🪲 Bug Fixes 🪲
[list]
[*] Clara's scattered papers no longer so grossly incandescent 
[*] Dice roll result no longer blurry
[*] Fixed an out-of-bounds situation (dont go looking no more)
[*] Fixed inconsistencies in Spark Scoring
[*] Pokerchips achievement should work now
[*] Jeremy stays lashless when found in his sad space after helping Lady
[*] Notebook no longer respawns after initially finding it
[*] Volume crank no longer has weird red square on it
[/list]
